verdict.rationale: Stripe's dispute docs say the Dashboard guides dispute responses and that Smart Disputes automates evidence collection and submission. Generic registrable webhooks and an MCP server give agents programmatic access to the Stripe API. Nothing in the pack ties these to dispute deadlines or to a draft-for-review step, and Smart Disputes is described as automated submission, not drafting. Missing for 10: documented dispute-deadline fields or dispute webhook events, an evidence-draft review workflow before submission, Terminal-specific dispute coverage, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor dispute deadlines via API or webhooks and draft evidence responses for my review

citations.quote: Use Smart Disputes to automate evidence collection and submission for eligible disputes.
After you register a webhook endpoint, Stripe pushes real-time data to it when events occur.
The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API
